summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Order History & Reorder feature (Iteration 15). Backend: 8/8 tests passed. Fixed critical bug in user_id extraction for orders list and favorite toggle. Fixed frontend bug in reorder availability check. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Backend list_orders() was using user.get('id') instead of user.get('user_id') - orders were not being returned for logged-in users
FIXED: Backend toggle_order_favorite() had same user_id extraction bug
FIXED: Frontend reorder availability check was checking for 'active'/'available' status instead of 'in_stock'
PATCH /api/orders/{id}/favorite correctly requires login (401 without auth)
PATCH /api/orders/{id}/favorite returns 404 for non-existent order
PATCH /api/orders/{id}/favorite returns 403 for non-owner (unless admin)
PATCH /api/orders/{id}/favorite toggles starred boolean correctly
GET /api/orders returns user's own orders when authenticated
GET /api/orders?email=X returns orders matching contact_email for guest lookup
Guest lookup form shows correctly for non-logged-in users
Empty state with Browse menu CTA shows when no orders found
Change email button returns to guest lookup form
Favorites section shows starred orders pinned above All orders
Order rows show order number, date, status badge, fulfillment badge, total, items summary
Favorite toggle updates UI immediately with toast feedback
Reorder dialog shows available items with images, names, quantities, prices
Reorder dialog shows warnings for unavailable items (sold_out, seasonal, not on menu)
Reorder confirm adds items to cart and opens cart sidebar
Order tracking page has tracking-reorder-btn and tracking-view-all-btn
Navbar and BottomNav both have Orders link pointing to /orders
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test orders for admin user via mongosh: ORD-TEST-001 (pickup, delivered, 2 items), ORD-TEST-002 (delivery, completed, 1 item)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 Order History & Reorder fully tested. Key fixes applied: (1) Backend: Fixed user_id extraction in list_orders() and toggle_order_favorite() - was using user.get('id') instead of user.get('user_id'). (2) Frontend: Fixed reorder availability check - was checking for 'active'/'available' status instead of 'in_stock'. All features verified: Guest lookup form with email validation, empty state with Browse menu CTA, logged-in user orders list with favorites section, favorite toggle with toast feedback, reorder dialog with availability warnings, reorder confirm adds to cart, order tracking page with reorder button, navbar/bottomnav Orders links. Test orders seeded: ORD-TEST-001 and ORD-TEST-002 for admin@culinaryeditorial.com.
